Affiliate-Marketing-Auto 1.0.0 - Initial Release

- Automates the full affiliate marketing workflow: high-commission product discovery, content generation, link tracking, and revenue analysis.
- Supports multi-platform affiliate networks (Amazon, ShareASale, CJ Affiliate) with smart filtering and market trend analysis.
- Generates SEO-optimized articles, social posts, email templates, and video scripts with multi-language support.
- Provides automatic link management, conversion tracking, A/B testing, and performance dashboards.
- Offers income reporting, trend forecasting, and report export in CSV/PDF.
